subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode support a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window to a compact summary bar, and accepting this request adds a new public lifecycle/config policy rather than repairing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept full preserved draft mode
options.body: Add a default-off Telegram-owned finalization option while keeping the current compact summary behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep compact summary only
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation and keep the current one-line activity digest as the supported post-turn state.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track checklist-style state in a broader structured progress-card design before adding a Telegram-specific config key.

recommendation.title: Accept full preserved draft mode
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Telegram-owned finalization option while keeping the current compact summary behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peetiegonzalez has the strongest recent history on the Telegram progress-window finalization path this decision would change.
